شبِ براءت کی فضیلت اکابر علماء اور سلفِ صالحین کی نظر میں:

نمبر ۵: اکثر لوگ بہت اہتمام سے پندرہویں شعبان کی رات قبرستان جاتے ہیں، اور اپنے رشتہ داروں اور بزرگوں کی قبروں کی زیارت کرتے ہیں، کیا یہ احادیث و روایات سے ثابت ہے یا نہیں؟ اور فقہاء اس سلسلہ میں کیا کہتے ہیں؟
نمبر ٦: اکثر خواتین پندرہویں شعبان کے دن مختلف قسم کے کھانے اور حلوے، مٹھائیاں بناتی ہیں اور بچوں اور رشتہ داروں میں تقسیم کرتی ہیں، کیا یہ عمل ثابت ہے یا نہیں؟
نمبر ۷: شبِ برا ء ت میں آتش بازی اور چراغاں اور مسجدوں کو سجانا شرعاً صحیح ہے یا نہیں؟
نمبر ۸: شبِ براءت میں اگر پوری رات نہ جاگا جائے بلکہ دوسری راتوں سے کچھ زیادہ عبادت کی جائے تو یہ عبادت بھی قیام اللیل میں محسوب ہو گی یا نہیں؟
نمبر ۹: کیا اس رات کا نام لیلۃ البراءت روایات سے ثابت ہے یا نہیں؟ اور لیلۃ البراءت کا کیا مطلب ہے؟ بینوا توجروا ۔
نمبر ۱۰: شعبان میں رسول اللہ ﷺ بکثرت روزے رکھتے تھے، اس کی کیا حکمت ہے؟ بینوا بالبرہان توجروا عند الرحمن ۔

نمبر ۱۱: میں نے سنا ہے کہ اللہ تعالی نے قرآنِ کریم کو اس رات (یعنی ۱۵ شعبان) میں لوحِ محفوظ سے آسمانِ دنیا پر اتارا، کیا یہ بات صحیح ہے؟ کیا قرآنِ کریم سے اس رات کی فضیلت ثابت ہے یا نہیں؟ إنا أنزلناه في ليلة…
نمبر ۱۲: شعبان کے بارے میں اردو میں جو رسالے لکھے گئے ہیں، برائے مطالعہ یا دوست احباب کو بتلانے کے لیے، ان میں چند کی نشاندہی فرما دیں؟
۱۳: شبِ براءت میں کوئی خاص دعا حدیث شریف میں منقول ہے یا نہیں؟ اگر ہے تو کتاب کے حوالہ سے دعا کی نشاندہی فرما دیں؟

نمبر ۱٤: پندرہویں شعبان میں اللہ تعالی کی طرف سے مغفرت کا دریا بہتا ہے، اور بے شمار لوگوں کی مغفرت کر دی جاتی ہے، لیکن کیا ایسے لوگ بھی ہیں جن کی اس مبارک رات میں بھی مغفرت نہیں ہوتی؟ اگر ہیں تو ان کی نشاندہی…
نمبر ۱۵: شبِ براءت میں دعا کی قبولیت سے متعلق کسی حدیث میں صراحت ہے یا نہیں؟ اگر ہے تو وہ حدیث کس درجہ کی ہے؟ نیز علمائے کرام اس بارے میں کیا کہتے ہیں؟
اگر کسی شخص نے فرض نماز پڑھی اور اس کے بعد احرام کی نیت کی، نفل نماز الگ سے نہیں پڑھی تو کیا یہ فرض نماز احرام کی سنت نماز کی طرف سے کافی ہو گی یا نہیں؟ یعنی احرام کی سنت ادا ہوئی یا نہیں؟
کیا بال کاٹنے والی مشین اگر زیرو نمبر پر ہو تو استرے کے قائم مقام ہو گی یا نہیں؟ نیز اگر بال پورے سے کم ہو تو مشین پھیرنے سے احرام سے نکل جائے گا یا نہیں؟ بینوا توجروا ۔
ایک شخص نے احرام باندھا سلے ہوے کپڑے نکال کر چادریں پہن لیں، لیکن زیر جامہ (underwear) نکالنا بھول گیا، اب کیا عمرہ ادا ہوا یا نہیں؟ کوئی جزا واجب ہوئی یا نہیں؟

ایک شخص نے احرام کی حالت میں خواب دیکھا کہ اس کو احتلام ہوا، اس نے غسل کیا، لیکن احرام کی چادریں صاف تھیں کوئی منی کا دھبہ وغیرہ نظر نہیں آیا، اس کے پاس دوسرا احرام نہیں تھا اس لیے اسی کو پہن لیا، اور عمرہ کا…
کیا طواف کے دوران دوستوں کے ساتھ بے تکلفی سے بات چیت کرنا جائز ہے یا نہیں؟
اگر کوئی شخص روزانہ عمرہ کرے تو کیا ہر عمرہ کے بعد حلق کرنا ضروری ہوگا؟

منی سے نماز فجر کے بعد سورج نکلنے بعد عرفات جاتے ہیں، لیکن ایک شخص یہ چاہتا ہے کہ پیدل حج کرے اور ٹھنڈے وقت میں عرفات پہنچ جائے، اس لیے وہ آخری شب میں چل دیتا ہے، دوسرا کہتا ہے کہ یہ خلاف سنت ہے سورج نکلنے کے…
اگر کوئی آفاقی اشہر حج میں اپنا عمرہ کرے، پھر مکہ مکرمہ سے میت کی طرف سے حج بدل کرے جس نے وصیت نہیں کی تھی تو کیا دمِ تمتع واجب ہو گا یا نہیں؟ بینوا توجروا ۔

ایک آدمی قتل کے مقدمہ کی وجہ سے مدتِ دراز سے جیل میں تھا، اسی درمیان میں اس کی ایک زمین فروخت ہوئی اور صاحب نصاب بن گیا، اور اس پر حج فرض ہو گیا، اتفاقاً جیل ہی میں اس آدمی کا انتقال ہو گیا، اب اس کے مال میں…

ایک شخص ایک سے زائد عمرے کرتا رہتا ہے، بہت سی مرتبہ احرام میلا ہو جاتا ہے یا کچھ مشروب وغیرہ اس پر گرنے کی وجہ سے گندہ ہو جاتا ہے تو کیا ہر بار احرام دھونا اور صاف احرام پہننا ضروری ہے یا ایسے احرام میں عمرہ…
اگر کسی نے چوری کے مال سے یا حرام مال سے حج کیا تو کیا اس کا حج ادا ہوا یا نہیں؟ یا اس کو دو بارہ حج کرنا ہوگا؟ بینوا توجروا ۔

فقہ کی کتابوں میں مرقوم ہے کہ اگر کسی کے پاس زاد و راحلہ موجود ہے تو اس پر حج فرض ہے اور عورتوں کے بارے میں یہ مرقوم ہے اگر اس کے پاس محرم موجود نہ ہو تو اس کے لیے حج میں جانا جائز نہیں، اب دونوں مسئلوں کی…

کیا فرماتے ہیں علمائے دین و مفتیان شرع متین مسئلہ ذیل کے بارے میں کہ اگر ایک عورت کو ہوائی جہاز کے ذریعہ ایک جگہ سے (جہاں وہ رہتی ہے) دوسری جگہ (والدین کی زیارت کے لیے) جانا ہو، اور راستہ تقریبا ٤۰ سے ٤۵ منٹ…
کیا حالتِ احرام میں ٹوتھ پیسٹ استعمال کرنا جائز ہے یا نہیں؟ جب کہ اس میں کچھ خوشبو ہوتی ہے، اگر کسی نے استعمال کر لی تو کوئی جزا واجب ہو گی یا نہیں؟ بینوا توجروا ۔
ایک آدمی نے عمرہ کیا اور حرم سے باہر اپنی قیام گاہ پر حلق کیا، کیا اس پر کوئی چیز واجب ہے یا نہیں؟ اب اس کو کیا کرنا چاہیے؟ بینوا توجروا ۔
اگر کسی آدمی نے عمرہ کے تمام افعال کیے لیکن سر منڈانے سے پہلے دوسرے عمرہ کا احرام باندھا اور اس کو مکمل کیا، کیا اس پر کوئی چیز واجب ہے یا نہیں؟
ایک عورت نے عمرہ کیا، پھر زیارت کے لیے طائف گئی، جب واپس آئی تو عمرہ کی نیت نہیں کی اس لیے کہ طبیعت صحیح نہیں تھی، اب وہ گھر واپس آ گئی، اب اس عورت پر کیا لازم ہوگا؟ دم ہوگا یا نہیں؟

اگر کسی شخص نے مصنوعی بالوں کی وگ لگوائی ہے اور سر میں بہت سارے زخم ہیں جن کی وجہ سے حج کے بعد حلق یا قصر انتہائی دشوار ہے یا کچھ ٹھیک ہو رہا ہے لیکن پھر بھی بعض وجوہات کی وجہ سے قصر یا حلق نہیں کر سکتا ہے تو…

میں نے سنا ہے کہ عرب علماء کے نزدیک اگر زمزم کے ساتھ عام پانی ملا دیا جائے تو زمزم کا پانی اپنی ہیئت پر باقی نہیں رہتا، وہ بھی عام پانی ہو جاتا ہے، جب کہ ہمارے علماء اس کو زمزم ہی کہتے ہیں، اب اس کا کیا حکم…
نبی کریم ﷺ کا نکاح ازواجِ مطہرات کے ساتھ کون سے مہینے کی کون سی تاریخ کو ہوا تھا؟ سال کون سا تھا؟ اور دن میں ہوا تھا یا رات میں ؟ بينوا بالتفصيل.
رسول اللہ ﷺ کا نکاح حضرت خدیجہ رضی اللہ تعالی عنہا کے ساتھ کس نے پڑھایا ۔ اس کا حوالہ درکار ہے؟ اور حوالہ مضبوط ہے یا اس پر کلام ہے؟ اگر کلام ہے تو کیا کلام ہے؟ نیز وہ خطبہ کیا تھا؟

" أمسوا بالإملاك فإنه أعظم بركة" یہ حدیث میں نے کسی جگہ پڑھی ہے اس کا مطلب یہ ہے کہ شام کے وقت نکاح کرنا چاہیے، تو کیا شام کے وقت یا رات کے وقت نکاح کرنا مستحب ہے؟ اور جمعہ کی شام کو نکاح کی فضیلت کسی روایت…

نکاح پڑھانے کے وقت کون سا خطبہ پڑھنا چاہیے؟ اور کہاں سے ثابت ہے؟ حضرت فاطمہ رضی اللہ تعالی عنہا کے نکاح کے وقت آنحضرت ﷺ نے کون سا خطبہ پڑھا تھا؟ میں نے سنا ہے کہ ام حبیبہ رضی اللہ تعالی عنہا کا نکاح نجاشی نے…
کیا وکیل گواہ بن سکتا ہے یا نہیں؟ یعنی ایک مجلس میں دولہا موجود تھا اور ایک گواہ تھا اور لڑکی کی طرف سے ایک وکیل تھا جو گواہ بھی تھا، ان تین کے علاوہ کوئی اور موجود نہیں تھا، کیا نکاح ہوا یا نہیں؟

ایک شخص کی ایک لڑکی سے منگنی ہوئی، منگنی کی مجلس میں ۸، ۱۰ آدمی موجود تھے، لڑکی کے والد نے کہا: بس ہم نے لڑکے کو لڑکی دی ہے، لڑکے نے کہا: ہم نے قبول کی ہے، خطبہ، رجسٹر وغیرہ کچھ نہیں تھا، اب لڑکی والے منگنی…
اگر منگنی میں جانبین نکاح کا لفظ استعمال کریں، لیکن مہر، خطبہ اور گواہوں کی گواہی کا تذکرہ نہ ہو اور ایجاب و قبول ہو جائے تو نکاح منعقد ہوگا یا نہیں؟ بینوا توجروا ۔

ایک لڑکے نے ایک لڑکی کو میسیج کیا کہ کہو میں نے نکاح قبول کیا، اس لڑکی نے بلا قصد و ارادہ یہ میسیج بھیج دیا کہ میں نے قبول کیا، نکاح ہوا یا نہیں؟ کیونکہ اب یہ لڑکی کسی اور سے نکاح کرنا چاہتی ہے تو کیا نکاح کر…
کسی حدیث میں یہ وارد ہوا ہے کہ نکاح نصف الایمان ہے، یا اس کے ہم معنی کوئی روایت موجود ہے؟ اگر ہے تو اس کا کیا درجہ ہے؟ بینوا بالدلیل ۔

اگر کوئی شخص اسکائپ کال (جس میں ایک دوسرے کا چہرہ دیکھتے ہوے بات چیت کرتے ہیں) کے ذریعہ نکاح کرے جس میں دو گواہ عاقدین کی بات چیت سنتے ہیں اور چہرہ بھی دیکھتے ہیں، تو ایسی صورت میں نکاح منعقد ہو جائے گا یا…

ایک نو مسلم لڑکی کا نکاح ایک مسلمان مرد سے ہوا اور نکاح کے گواہوں میں اس کا بھائی اور والد تھا اور دونوں غیر مسلم تھے اور دونوں کا اصرار تھا کہ گواہ بن جائیں، اور نکاح پڑھانے والا مسلمان تھا، تو اس حالت میں…

ایک صوفی صاحب نے ایک لڑکی کا نکاح ایک لڑکے سے پڑھایا، نکاح پڑھاتے وقت لڑکی کا نام نہیں لیا بلکہ یہ کہا کہ فلان کی لڑکی کا نکاح میں نے آپ سے کر دیا اور یہ کہا کہ لڑکی کا نام چھپانے کی چیز ہے، نکاح کی مجلس میں…

آج کل شادی کے دعوت نامہ پر بغرضِ تعارف دولہا دلہن کا نام لکھتے ہیں، بعض لوگ اشکال کرتے ہیں کہ لڑکی کا نام لکھنا درست نہیں، کیا کہیں صحیح احادیث یا آثارِ صحابہ سے یہ ثابت ہے کہ دعوت نامہ پر لڑکی کا نام لکھنے سے…

عام طور پر ہندوستان، پاکستان میں لوگ محرم میں خصوصاً پہلے دس دنوں میں شادی نہیں کرتے، اور اس کو عیب یا منحوس سمجھتے ہیں، شرعاً اس کا کیا حکم ہے؟ کیا ازواجِ مطہرات اور بناتِ طاہرات میں سے کسی کا نکاح محرم ہوا…

ایک لڑکی کی والدہ کا انتقال ہو گیا، اس کے والد نے بڑی عمر میں ایک نوجوان عورت سے شادی کی، اس کا ایک بھائی ہے، کیا اس لڑکی کا نکاح اپنی سوتیلی والدہ کے بھائی یعنی سوتیلے ماموں سے جائز ہے یا نہیں؟ بینوا توجروا ۔
کیا کوئی شخص اپنی بیوی کی سوتیلی نواسی (بیوی کی سوتیلی بیٹی کی بیٹی) کے ساتھ نکاح کر سکتا ہے یا نہیں؟ بینوا توجروا ۔

ایک لڑکی کا نکاح ہوا اور خلوتِ صحیحہ بھی ہوئی، لیکن وہ باقاعدہ لڑکے کے ہاں دوسرے ملک نہیں گئی، شادی کو تین ماہ گزر چکے ہیں، اب سوال یہ ہے کہ کیا گزشتہ تین ماہ کا نفقہ طلب کر سکتی ہے یا نہیں؟ نیز آئندہ کے نفقہ…

ایک شخص اپنے مکان میں اپنے بھائی کو بھی رکھتا ہے، اس کی بیوی کا کہنا ہے کہ مکان چھوٹا ہے اور میرے لیے پریشانی کی بات ہے، جب کہ وہ کچھ کام نہیں کرتا پورا دن گھر میں رہتا ہے، پورا دن پر دہ بھی مشکل ہے تواب کیا…

میاں بیوی کے درمیان کسی وجہ سے طلاق ہو گئی، ان کی ایک چار سالہ بچی ہے، اب عورت نے دوسری شادی کر لی اور اپنے شوہر اور بچی کے ساتھ دوسرے ملک کا سفر کر لیا جہاں بچی کے باپ کی رسائی نہیں ہے، کیا بچی کی ماں کے لیے…

زید اور اس کی بیوی کے درمیان کچھ نا اتفاقی ہو گئی، بیوی میکے آ گئی ہزار کوشش کے بعد بھی آنے کے لیے تیار نہیں ہوئی، بیوی نے ایک شرط لگائی کہ اگر کسی وجہ سے ان دونوں کے درمیان طلاق ہو جائے تو زید یعنی باپ کو بچے…

ایک شخص کی عمر ٦۰ سال کی ہے اس کے بیٹے کی شادی ہو گئی، بہو کی عمر ۲۵ سال کی ہے، کیا خسر کے لیے جائز ہے کہ اپنی بہو کے ساتھ عیدین وغیرہ خوشی کے مواقع میں معانقہ کرے؟ بینوا توجروا ۔

حرمتِ مصاہرت میں اگر کوئی شخص شہوت کا انکار کر دے تو حرمتِ مصاہرت ثابت ہو گی یا نہیں؟ عام طور پر فقہاء نے لکھا ہے کہ اگر ایسی جگہ بوسہ دیا یا چھوا جو بطورِ شہوت ہی چھوا جاتا ہے تو انکار کے باوجود حرمت ثابت ہو…

شوہر کی اطاعت سے متعلق ایک حدیث سننے میں آئی ہے؛ جس کا خلاصہ یہ ہے کہ ایک شخص سفر پر گیا اور بیوی کو بتلا گیا کہ گھر سے باہر نہ جائے اور اس کے والد نچلے منزلہ میں رہتے تھے، وہ بیمار ہو گئے، عورت نے حضور ﷺ سے…

ایک شخص کا اپنی بیوی سے جھگڑا ہوا اور غصہ کی حالت میں اس نے اپنی بیوی سے یہ الفاظ کہے:" میری طرف سے تم فری ہو جہاں پے جانا چاہتی ہو جاؤ "لیکن اس کو یہ معلوم نہیں ہے کہ تین مرتبہ کہا یا ایک مرتبہ کیا ان الفاظ…

how a resident latecomer completes his prayer behind a travelling imam a latecomer joined a travelling imam at the final tashahhud how should he complete his prayer our senior scholars have differed on this question some of them say that once the travelling imam has finished such a man is a l iq one who has fallen behind as well as a latecomer he therefore performs the first two rak ahs without reciting since in respect of them he is a l iq and performs the third and fourth rak ahs with recitation this is the answer written by muft az z al ra m n the chief muft of deoband and it bears the signatures of shaykh al hind may allah have mercy on him mawl n ashraf al th nw may allah have mercy on him and a rat mawl n anwar sh h kashm r these scholars argue from the following words of sh m

how a resident latecomer completes his prayer behind a travelling imam in the noon prayer a latecomer joined a travelling imam in the second rak ah of the noon prayer how should he complete the rest of his prayer scholars differ on this question according to the verifying scholars however the resident follower leaves off following the imam and becomes one praying alone he therefore performs all three remaining rak ahs as a latecomer does he performs the first of them with the recitation of al f ti ah and a s rah and then sits and he performs the last two with al f ti ah alone and does not sit between them al durr al mukht r states

how a follower who falls behind the imam completes his prayer a man's ablution broke during the second rak ah and by the time he had gone and performed ablution two rak ahs had passed how should he now perform his prayer after the imam gives the sal m in the case asked about after performing ablution he should pray the rak ahs that he missed because of the ritual impurity and he should do so without reciting then if the imam is still in the prayer he should join him otherwise he should complete his prayer on his own al durr al mukht r states

appointing a substitute when the imam's ablution breaks after the first sal m if a man's ablution breaks after he has given the sal m once is his prayer complete or not or should he perform ablution come back and give the second sal m and if he is the imam what is the ruling should he appoint someone to take his place or not according to the sounder view the second sal m is necessary so the man in question should perform ablution return and give the second sal m and if he is the imam he should appoint someone to take his place al durr al mukht r states al a w states al durr al mukht r states

a follower stepping forward as substitute imam without being appointed if an imam's ablution broke and he left and then a man came forward on his own from the second or third row and completed the prayer was the prayer valid or not if the follower took the imam's place before the imam had left the mosque and completed the prayer the prayer is valid whatever extended movement occurred was for the sake of putting the prayer right so it does not invalidate it care must be taken however that this does not involve turning one's back to the qiblah for otherwise the prayer becomes invalid fat w q kh n states sh m states

reciting from a written copy of the qur'an during prayer is it permissible to recite in prayer while looking at a copy of the qur'an or not and if it is permissible according to which imam in the view of the hanafis reciting from a written copy of the qur'an while in prayer invalidates the prayer the prayer becomes void whether it is an obligatory prayer a voluntary one or tar w al a w 's notes state

switching off a ringing mobile phone during prayer with extended movement if switching off a mobile phone calls for extended movement does the prayer become invalid or not extended movement invalidates the prayer so in the case asked about if extended movement was involved in switching off the mobile phone the prayer becomes invalid imd d al fatt states

saying to someone who sneezes during prayer a man sneezed during the prayer and said and another man answered him with has the prayer of either of them become invalid or not the man who sneezed and said has not invalidated his prayer though he should not say it deliberately the man who answered him with however has invalidated his prayer al a w 's notes state imd d al fatt states

a hanafi behind a sh fi imam who omitted the final sitting and prostrated for forgetfulness in the fifth rak ah a hanafi was praying behind a sh fi imam the sh fi imam did not sit at the fourth rak ah and then performed the prostration of forgetfulness in the fifth rak ah is the hanafi follower's prayer valid or not in the case asked about the sh fi imam did something that in the hanafi view is one of the things that invalidate the prayer the hanafi follower's prayer is therefore invalid and he must repeat the obligatory prayer fat w sh m states ta r r al mukht r states al a w s

a woman follower prompting the imam during prayer if a woman was praying behind an imam and she prompted him should the imam accept her prompt or not when a woman is among the followers and the imam makes a mistake during the prayer she should clap that is strike one hand against the other rather than prompt him aloud if she does prompt him aloud the imam should avoid taking the prompt from her and if he does take it no invalidity is caused to the prayer because according to the sounder view a woman's voice is not awrah something that must be kept concealed imd d al fatt states al ba r al r iq states

replying to a greeting in prayer with the words if someone greeted a man who was praying and in reply the man said the words what is the ruling on his prayer since this supplication was uttered by way of a reply and since in common usage such words are used to convey a greeting to another person out of caution the prayer is treated as invalid a al bukh r states imd d al fatt states

whether saying invalidates the prayer a man was praying either behind an imam or on his own and he began to say is his prayer valid or not and does it make a difference whether he did so by mistake or deliberately in the case asked about if he said by way of a reply or in order to alert someone the prayer becomes invalid whether he did so deliberately or by mistake but if he said it to drive away distracting thoughts or simply as a remembrance of allah then in both cases the prayer does not become invalid even if he said it deliberately al lamg riyyah states al a w

praying with chewing gum in the mouth a man had chewing gum in his mouth while praying and a little of its sweetness was going down his throat is his prayer valid or not in the case asked about the prayer is invalid there are in general several cases of praying with something in the mouth 1 if it is something sweet and its sweetness reaches the stomach it invalidates the prayer 2 if its sweetness has gone but the person keeps chewing it this too invalidates the prayer 3 if what is in the mouth is small and does not hinder recitation it does not invalidate the prayer but the prayer is disliked 4 if it is large and hinders recitation it invalidates the prayer sh m states

praying with a bottle of urine in one's pocket if a man has in his pocket a rotten egg whose contents have turned to blood or a bottle filled with urine is his prayer valid or not filth does not invalidate the prayer so long as it is in its natural place and source but it does invalidate the prayer when it is not in its natural place so in the case asked about if a man prayed with a bottle of urine in his pocket his prayer is invalid but if he prayed with a rotten egg full of blood in his pocket his prayer is valid because the filth is in its natural place sh m states al ba r al r iq states

a woman praying with some of her hair uncovered a woman prayed while some of her hair was showing is her prayer valid or not if as much as a quarter of the hair remained uncovered the prayer is invalid but if less than a quarter remained uncovered the prayer is not invalid al a w 's notes state sh m states fat w al laknaw stat

whether a kiss between a man and a woman during prayer invalidates the prayer the books of fiqh generally state that if a man is praying and a woman kisses him his prayer does not become invalid but that if a woman is praying and a man kisses her her prayer does become invalid if this ruling is correct what is the reason for the difference between the two cases on this question the verifying scholar ibn al hum m may allah have mercy on him said that is allah knows best the reason for the difference all mah abd al ayy al laknaw may allah have mercy on him said that analogy would require the prayer to be invalid in both cases but that the woman's prayer is invalid because a man's kiss has the status of intercourse in her regard since she is already receptive to it unlike a kiss given by a woman he gave a second reason as well that desire is generally stronger in women than in men so when a man kisses a woman she too feels desire and her prayer therefore becomes invalid that a man's kiss should invalidate

supplicating in prayer in a language other than arabic or with words resembling ordinary speech when a certain woman prays she recites this supplication in english while in prostration or while sitting o allah protect my husband and my children has this woman's prayer become invalid or not supplicating in a language other than arabic during prayer is strictly disliked makr h ta r m and any supplication that resembles ordinary human speech invalidates the prayer so in the case asked about the woman's prayer has become invalid and she should repeat it fat w q kh n states o allah forgive me

removing the doubt that using a loudspeaker invalidates the prayer some people declare praying aloud over a loudspeaker impermissible or at least doubtful is prayer over a loudspeaker sound or not and what is the reality of the objection raised about it namely that the congregation is taking its cue from someone other than the imam jad d fiqh mas il states is prayer by means of a loudspeaker valid or not in the beginning the scholars differed over this question some were of the view that the sound of a loudspeaker is not the imam's own voice but an echo of that voice on that view the movements of the followers would be based on a second sound rather than on the imam's voice and it is not permissible for a follower to move on the voice of anyone other than the imam against this others held that the use of a loudspeaker for prayer is nevertheless correct and that there is a precedent for it in the sharia a case in which worshippers moved on the word of a man who was outside the prayer when the ka bah repl

further research on praying over a loudspeaker some people declare praying aloud over a loudspeaker impermissible or at least doubtful is prayer over a loudspeaker sound or not and what is the reality of the objection raised about it namely that the congregation is taking its cue from someone other than the imam praying over a loudspeaker is permissible and sound without any doubt and it is not correct to declare it doubtful consider the following evidence that is if a worshipper acts on words spoken by someone outside the prayer his prayer is not invalidated the importance of acting on words spoken by someone outside the prayer appears in the question of praying over a loudspeaker some scholars say that prayer over a loudspeaker is not valid or that it is doubtful their reasoning is that the sound reaching the follower is not really the imam's voice the loudspeaker

switching off a ringing cell phone during prayer with a slight movement if a cell phone starts ringing during prayer may one switch it off with a slight movement or not if a phone rings during prayer it is permissible to switch it off with a slight movement that is to slip one hand into the pocket and turn it off the prayer will not be invalidated though it will be disliked a worshipper should put his phone on silent or switch it off before he begins to pray and should take particular care about this but if for some reason he forgets and it starts ringing during the prayer he should switch it off at once with a slight movement because a phone that goes on ringing causes real annoyance to the other worshippers and also disturbs his own prayer a hadith relates that the prophet was once leading the prayer when the sound of a child crying was he

praying with a jacket draped over the shoulders if a person drapes a jacket over his shoulders during prayer and does not put his arms through the sleeves does this create any fault or defect in the prayer or not draping a coat over the shoulders in this way during prayer without putting the arms through the sleeves comes under the ruling of sadl letting a garment hang loose and this is disliked so in the case asked about the prayer will be disliked consider what al hid yah states

letting the ends of a shawl or scarf hang loose in prayer is there any defect in the prayer if the worshipper lets one end of his scarf or shawl hang down or both ends and leaves them loose if he places one end of the scarf or shawl over his shoulder there is no defect in the prayer but if he leaves both ends loose and lets them hang the prayer will be disliked consider what imd d al fatt states

praying with the sleeves rolled up what is the position on praying with the sleeves rolled up that is leaving the elbows uncovered during prayer praying with the sleeves rolled up for no reason is disliked if a person has rolled them up for ablution or for some other reason he should roll them down and then begin the prayer if in his eagerness to catch a rak ah he has already entered the prayer it is better to roll them down little by little in a way that does not amount to a substantial action imd d al fatt states radd al mu t r states

hitching up the trousers when going into bowing or prostration if a worshipper gathers up his trousers or shirt as he goes down into prostration does this create any flaw in the prayer or not lifting the trousers with both hands while going down into bowing or prostration makes the prayer disliked but the prayer is not invalidated still making such a movement in prayer and turning it into a habit is objectionable and disliked and it may well lead to a substantial action and so become a cause of the prayer's invalidity avoiding it is therefore necessary imd d al fatt states

praying in the long kurtas kept at the mosque these days mosques keep long kurtas and ordinary people who come to pray straight from work put one on and pray in it since they do not think it proper to pray in their working clothes is there any dislike in praying this way or not some people say that because one would not go to a public gathering in these garments the prayer ought to be disliked is that correct on the face of it praying in such clothes is not disliked because they cover the body better than the person's own clothes do besides these clothes produce a kind of humility in the prayer when a man comes to allah's court he performs his worship in a garment set aside for it rather than in fashionable clothes furthermore the jurists agree that praying with the sleeves rolled up is disliked and some fatwa collections such as fat w ma m diyyah and fat w ra miyyah indicate that praying in sleeveless clothes is disliked as well so no dislike will arise in the prayer from these garments as for the view of some that they should be disliked because one does not go to a public ga

yawning in prayer and letting out the sound h h h h when a yawn comes during prayer should one place the right hand over the mouth or the left and when people let out the sound h h h h is that strictly disliked or mildly disliked yawning in prayer is an act of satan and should be avoided as far as one is able still if it comes involuntarily then in the standing position one should place the right hand over the mouth so that there is not too much movement and in the other postures one should use the left hand as for letting out the sound h h h h if it is done deliberately it is strictly disliked if it is involuntary it is excused just as certain letters escape a person when he sneezes though even then it is not free of dislike consider what radd al mu t r states

praying with coins bearing an image in one's pocket if metal coins bearing a raised image are kept in the pocket is the prayer valid or not having coins bearing an image in the pocket does no harm to the prayer they should however be kept carefully so that they do not fall on the place of prostration consider what imd d al fatt states radd al mu t r states

reciting a supplication in a language other than arabic during prayer if a person recited this supplication in urdu while sitting in prayer o allah forgive all the muslims what is the ruling on his prayer according to the preferred view supplicating in a language other than arabic during prayer is strictly disliked though there is also a view that it is only mildly disliked so if the person did not repeat that prayer there is no harm in it according to the view of some scholars consider what radd al mu t r states fat w q kh n states

praying with something the size of a chickpea in the mouth something the size of a chickpea was left in a man's mouth and he came to know of it only after the prayer was his prayer valid or not if something the size of a chickpea remains in the mouth the prayer will not be invalidated the prayer will however be disliked al fat w al t t rkh niyyah states fat al qad r states al fat w al hindiyyah states

lifting both feet during prostration for the length of three tasb s if someone lifted both feet during prostration for the length of three tasb s and then put them down again was his prayer valid or not keeping some part of the feet on the ground during prostration even a single toe is obligatory and indispensable without it the prayer is not valid since in the case asked about he put his feet down again after lifting them the prostration was performed it was however contrary to the sunnah method and for that reason the prayer will be disliked imd d al fatt states

praying in places where music is played will the prayer be valid if it is performed in places where music is played such as a market and the like if the place of prayer is separate and the sound of the music does not reach it there is no harm in praying there but praying in a place where music is played when the sound reaches the worshipper and disturbs his prayer is not free of dislike a hadith states that the prophet forbade praying in foul and unsuitable places any place where music is played comes under the same ruling so the prayer will be disliked consider what al bayhaq records imd d al fatt states

the imam's sutrah is sufficient for all the followers in a prayer hall the way in is at the end of the first row and worshippers keep arriving even after the prayer has begun so they usually have to pass in front of the followers there is a wall in front of the imam which serves as his sutrah the screen set up before a worshipper but it is not a sutrah for the followers will the wall in front of the imam be sufficient as a sutrah for all the followers or not the imam's sutrah is sufficient for all the followers so no other sutrah is needed however once the congregational prayer has ended if worshippers are praying their sunnah prayers passing in front of them will be forbidden likewise if a latecomer prays the part he missed after the imam's prayer has ended he too does not need a sutrah imd d al fatt states radd al mu t r states

a sh fi praying witr as three rak ahs with one sal m behind a hanafi imam if a sh fi prays the witr prayer behind a hanafi that is three rak ahs units of prayer with a single sal m is his witr valid or not the witr of a sh fi who follows a hanafi imam is valid and correct this is because according to the sh fi s witr may be prayed as one rak ah three five seven nine or at most eleven imam al nawaw may allah have mercy on him held in shar al muhadhdhab that joining the three rak ahs together with a single sal m is better since it avoids the disagreement so in the case asked about the witr prayer is valid shar al muhadhdhab states

a hanafi praying witr with two sal ms behind a sh fi imam if a hanafi prays the witr prayer behind a sh fi with two sal ms what is the ruling if the sh fi imam leads three rak ahs units of prayer with a single sal m the hanafi's witr is valid if he leads it with two sal ms then the hanafi follower should stand up and complete his own witr his witr is valid and there is no need to pray it again al ba r al r iq states fat al qad r states

not adding a s rah in the third rak ah of witr out of ignorance a man used to treat the witr prayer like the maghrib prayer and did not add a s rah in the third rak ah unit of prayer now that he has learned the ruling does he have to make up all his past witr prayers or not adding a s rah after s rat al f ti ah in the third rak ah of witr is necessary and not knowing the ruling is no excuse so in the case asked about he must make up all the past witr prayers that he prayed without adding a s rah consider what imd d al fatt states shiyat al a w al mar q al fal states

praying witr before tar w a man prayed the witr prayer before tar w is he now required to repeat the witr or not it is permissible to pray witr before tar w as well though praying it after tar w is better so in the case asked about the witr prayer was valid and there is no need to repeat it consider what mar q al fal states al durr al mukht r states

reciting the qun t supplication when in doubt about the number of rak ahs of witr if someone becomes unsure about the number of rak ahs units of prayer in witr whether he has prayed two or three in which rak ah should he recite the qun t in the case asked about he should recite the qun t supplication in the very rak ah in which the doubt arose and he should also sit since it may be that this is the third rak ah he should then stand up for the third rak ah recite the qun t in that one too and complete the rak ah and at the end perform the prostration of forgetfulness sajdah sahw consider what al durr al mukht r states khul at

reciting some other supplication when one does not know the qun t if a person does not know the qun t supplication what should he recite if a person does not know the qun t supplication he should say or he should say or he should say three times consider what mar q al fal states

reciting s rat al ikhl in place of the qun t supplication if a person cannot recite the well known qun t supplication because of old age or weakness may he recite s rat al ikhl in its place the hanafi jurists have said that whoever cannot recite the qun t supplication should say three times or or three times this is better he may indeed also recite s rat al ikhl because when a person does not know the qun t supplication no particular supplication is definitively fixed for him and praising the generous one amounts to asking of him consider what al ba r al r iq states

raising the hands to supplicate in the third rak ah of witr and the congregation saying am n some people raise their hands and make supplication in the third rak ah of witr the imam recites the supplication while those praying behind him raise their hands and say am n is this established by any authentic hadith or not doing this in the third rak ah of witr is not established by any authentic narration traced back to the prophet a few reports are related from the companions and the successors and most of them are weak on account of layth ibn ab sulaym moreover prayer rests on stillness and dignity so acting in this way is not good consider what mu annaf ibn ab shaybah states

the proofs of the sh fi s and anbal s for raising the hands in the qun t of witr the sh fi s and anbal s keep their hands raised throughout the qun t supplication in witr what are their proofs is there any explicit authentic hadith for this or not after a search through the books it emerges that the sh fi s and anbal s have no explicit narration traced back to the prophet on this point they have argued from one hadith found in al mustadrak of al kim but the verifying scholars have said that is this narration is not generally to be found in al mustadrak of al kim apart from that they argue from the practice of a few companions and from narrations about supplication in general in which the raising of the hands is mentioned consider the proofs of the sh fi s al bay n states

the wording of the qun t of calamity as given in the books of fiqh what wording of the qun t of calamity is recorded in the books of fiqh what should one recite may a person recite whatever he wishes the supplication recorded in sh m is what is generally practised and that is what should be recited suitable wording other than it may also be recited but what is in sh m is better long wording sometimes becomes a burden for those praying behind and at times the standing after bowing even ends up longer than the second rak ah itself consider what sh m states n r al

reciting supplications other than the transmitted one in the qun t of calamity is it permissible to recite supplications other than the sunnah one in the qun t of calamity and what is the ruling if the imam adds other supplications alongside the sunnah one supplications other than the one that has been transmitted may also be recited in the qun t supplication provided they are not like worldly requests for example o allah grant a gold mine in such and such a place or arrange my marriage to such and such a girl sh m records this supplication all mah al khw razm has recorded a similar supplication in al kif yah shar al hid yah at 1 379

reciting the qun t of calamity to ward off afflictions should the qun t of calamity be recited for warding off afflictions for thirty days only or for longer than that when and at what time is it recited may it be recited in the fourth rak ah of ish the qun t of calamity should be recited to ward off afflictions and there is no limit of thirty days it is recited for as long as the affliction and trial is widespread it is recited in the second rak ah of fajr in the standing after bowing and it may also be recited in the fourth rak ah of ish consider what al durr al mukht r states

what imam al a w means by calling the qun t of calamity abrogated when the muslims fall into difficulty the qun t of calamity is recited in the fajr prayer imam al a w may allah have mercy on him however calls it abrogated what does this statement of his mean two statements are related from imam al a w may allah have mercy on him 1 that the qun t in fajr is abrogated 2 that it is established the two may be reconciled by saying that it is permissible in a severe calamity but not in ordinary warfare or that what imam al a w may allah have mercy on him means by his expression is that it is not a sunnah even though it is permissible it may also be said that this statement of imam al a w may allah have mercy on him is not what the jurists act upon shar ma n al th r states

folding or letting down the hands during the qun t of calamity in the fajr prayer when the imam recites the qun t supplication in the fajr prayer should one fold the hands or let them hang at one's sides in this matter the hanafi school permits both and no one should reproach anyone else over it the settled practice however is to let the hands hang consider what al hid yah states shar al in yah states

performing an emphasised sunnah sitting down without an excuse may a person pray the sunnah of zuhr sitting down without an excuse or not performing the sunnah of zuhr sitting down is permissible and valid even without an excuse shiyat al a w states

repeating an optional prayer sitting down after it has been invalidated a man began an optional prayer standing and then for some reason it was invalidated may he now perform it sitting down or not an optional prayer becomes binding and necessary once it has been begun so its ruling is now that of a necessary prayer in the case asked about therefore it is not permissible to perform it sitting down consider what sh m states imd d al fatt states

making up the sunnah prayers along with the obligatory prayers if a person prayed both the sunnah prayer and the obligatory prayer without ablution then when he remembers this and makes the prayer up will he make up the sunnah as well or not if he remembers while the time is still in and wants to pray again after performing ablution he should pray the sunnah prayers again too if he wants to make the prayer up after its time has gone then only the obligatory prayers are made up the sunnah prayers are not made up only the sunnah of fajr may be made up along with the obligatory prayer before the sun passes its zenith consider what shar ma n al th r states

repeating a sunnah or optional prayer performed without ablution if a person prayed a sunnah or an optional prayer without ablution is he obliged to make it up on account of the rule or not in the case asked about he is not obliged to make it up the meaning of is that the prayer was validly begun and then invalidated for some reason but in the case asked about beginning the prayer without ablution was not valid in the first place bad i al an i states

praying the sunnah of a r after a r when it has been broken off a man began the sunnah prayer that precedes a r and then broke it off because the congregational prayer had started may he pray it after a r praying it after a r is disliked making it up at a time other than the disliked times is correct if someone does pray it then however it will be performed with the dislike attached that is it will be discharged from his responsibility consider what shar munyat al mu all states

praying a sunnah behind someone who is praying an obligatory prayer a man prayed zuhr behind an imam afterwards someone else was praying zuhr in another place may this man perform the sunnah of zuhr behind him in the case asked about it is permissible to pray a sunnah behind someone who is praying an obligatory prayer because a general intention is enough for the duty to be discharged as all mah sh m may allah have mercy on him has stated consider what sh m states

praying two rak ahs between the adh n and the iq mah for maghrib according to the four imams what is the ruling on praying two rak ahs between the adh n and the iq mah for maghrib according to the hanafis it is merely permitted the sh fi s have two positions 1 that it is recommended 2 that it is merely permitted according to the m lik s it is not recommended and some of them hold it to be abrogated according to the anbal s it is permissible but it is not a sunnah consider what al durr al mukht r states

praying four rak ahs before ish what is the ruling on praying four rak ahs before ish is it established from hadith or not the jurists have written that praying four rak ahs before ish is recommended and a hadith to this effect is mentioned in some books but this narration is not to be found in the books of hadith one may however argue from a general hadith the prophet said that there is a prayer between every adh n and iq mah what is meant in this hadith is prayer in the unqualified sense and that is two rak ahs yet in line with the principle of imam ab an fah may allah have mercy on him that at night it is better to pray four rak ahs with a single opening takb r the jurists have declared four rak ahs to be recommended and some have said that the matter is left to a person's choice a a

praying two optional rak ahs after witr is praying two optional rak ahs after witr established or not praying two optional rak ahs after witr is established from the hadiths and it is mentioned in various fatwas of the senior scholars as well it is not however mentioned in the books of fiqh but all mah sh m may allah have mercy on him has quoted this saying of imam ab an fah may allah have mercy on him on that basis praying two rak ahs after witr will not take a person outside the bounds of the school on the contrary it will be acting upon the school itself since authentic hadiths are on record a rat gangoh may allah have mercy on him has also written this consider what a muslim states

praying two or four rak ahs after ish with the intention of tahajjud if a person is unable to wake up for tahajjud will he receive the reward of tahajjud by praying two or four rak ahs after ish or not tahajjud is in reality the prayer performed after waking from sleep so a person should make the effort to pray it in the last part of the night after sleeping and rising but if in spite of the effort getting up is difficult or a student remains occupied with his studies until late at night then if he prays two or four rak ahs with the intention of tahajjud before going to sleep it is hoped that he will receive the reward consider what al ba r al r iq states

praying tahajjud in congregation what is the position on deliberately praying tahajjud in congregation during the blessed month of ramadan praying tahajjud in congregation is disliked because congregation for optional prayers is disliked if on occasion one or two people follow someone without any general summons to gather there is room for it but keeping this up regularly is disliked it is better and preferable to pray it alone mar q al fal states

earning the reward of tahajjud by making up missed prayers at that time if a person prays his lifetime's missed prayers qa umr during the time of tahajjud will he receive the reward of tahajjud or not someone who prays his missed prayers during the time of tahajjud will receive the reward of the tahajjud prayer sh m states fat w aqq niyyah states if a person rises from sleep and makes up a prayer he has missed some jurists count this too as part of tahajjud
